parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow, typically for hot or cold water control.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the internal valve mechanism.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow, typically for hot or cold water control.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the internal valve mechanism.

parts.name: Frame (Body Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame or body base of the faucet, made of brass, connecting the spout and switches.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the structural support and internal channel for water flow between the inlet pipes and the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water exits.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet body to the sink area.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally depending on the faucet design, allowing directional control of water flow.
